notes: GNN-CB LLM baseline. Generated by Claude Opus 4.7 (claude-opus-4-7) under frozen prompt template prompt.md v1.1 (temperature=0, top_p=1, seed=42). Agent mode (Claude Code). Zero few-shot examples, zero per-task hints, zero prompt edits, zero repair iterations. Dual-submission GTA challenge on MUTAG: binary graph classification (mutagenic vs non-mutagenic) under (a) clean features and (b) perturbed features (constant shift delta=0.3 + Gaussian noise sigma=0.05). Pipeline: PyG TUDataset MUTAG (188 graphs, 7-dim atom one-hot, 4-dim bond one-hot); 2-layer GINEConv hidden=64 + BatchNorm + dropout=0.3 with per-layer Linear edge projector; mean+max pool + 2-layer MLP head; on-the-fly random perturbation augmentation during training (sampled per-batch delta in [0,0.4], sigma in [0,0.08]) for robustness; Adam lr=1e-3 wd=5e-4 batch=16; stratified internal 80/20 val split; early stop on val perturbed-F1 (matches leaderboard primary metric) patience=15 max 80 epochs; 5-seed soft-vote ensemble {42..46} on softmax probabilities. Local internal-val per-seed mean F1_ideal=0.7452+/-0.0445, F1_perturbed=0.8202+/-0.0364. CPU only, wall-clock ~7 s.
